style_summary: A high-energy, DIY punk zine mixed-media collage on a vibrant royal blue textured ground. The visual vocabulary strictly pairs completely grayscale vintage photographic cutouts with chaotic, mismatched magazine cutout typography (individual cut-and-paste letters). The graphic language is loud, featuring extremely rough white torn-paper borders and energetic hand-drawn marker doodles (arrows, scribbles) in bright safety orange and dark ink. The aesthetic is rebellious, adventurous, and distinctly handmade.

environment_variables.MAIN_SUBJECT: The central object, which MUST be a grayscale/black-and-white photographic cutout. e.g., 'a vintage prop airplane', 'a textured retro suitcase', or 'an antique desk globe'.
environment_variables.HEADLINE_TEXT: A short, punchy 1-3 word phrase to be spelled out in mismatched cut-out letters. e.g., 'GO', 'KEEP MOVING', or 'NEW HORIZON'.
environment_variables.DOODLE_THEME: The specific semantic shapes for the hand-drawn marker overlays. e.g., 'speed lines and paper airplanes' or 'directional arrows and cross marks'.

zones.typography_zone: Scattered dramatically around or overlapping the subject, acting as a chaotic, unaligned framing mechanism
zones.focal_zone: Dead center, dominated by a single large grayscale photographic cutout
zones.negative_space: The royal blue background, which is heavily invaded by doodles and torn paper corners

composition.depth_logic: Literal physical paper stacking. Base painted blue canvas -> torn white paper scraps -> grayscale photo cutout -> top layer marker doodles.
composition.scale_contrast: Bold and aggressive scale. Both the main subject and the cutout letters are oversized and in-your-face.
composition.edge_treatment: Extremely rough, jagged white torn-paper edges around ALL photos and individual text letters.
permissions: mismatching fonts for every single letter in a word
drawing marker lines directly over photographic cutouts and text

typography.letterform_character: Chaotic, mismatched, cut-and-paste, DIY punk scrapbook

hierarchy.style: A chaotic mix of serif, sans-serif, and bold fonts. Every individual letter uses a completely different typeface.
hierarchy.treatment: Each letter is a separate physical magazine cutout with rough torn-paper edges, OR a flat painted letter.
hierarchy.position: Floating independently, creating irregular bouncing baselines.
hierarchy.color_rule: Mix of grayscale newsprint background and solid neon_safety_orange

typography.readability_rule: Words must be legible, but the alignment, sizing, and fonts of individual letters must look physically cut-and-pasted by hand.
text_constraints: strictly NO cohesive, cleanly typed digital fonts for the main headline
must look like physical paper clippings gathered from different vintage magazines

color_constraints.dominant: royal_cobalt_blue must dominate the background entirely (min 60% area).
color_constraints.accent_roles: neon_safety_orange is strictly reserved for hand-drawn marker doodles and occasional solid-color text letters.
color_constraints.special_rules: ALL photographic subjects MUST be completely grayscale/black-and-white. Zero color is allowed inside the photos.
forbidden: any background color other than royal blue

visual_direction.lighting: Flat scanner lighting. No realistic global shadows.
visual_direction.mood: Energetic, youthful, rebellious, wanderlust, DIY punk.
visual_direction.material_textures: Painted rough canvas background, glossy magazine paper cutouts, dry marker ink strokes.
visual_direction.surface_quality: Matte paper with visible paper grain and marker bleed.

marker_doodles.physical: Bright orange and dark ink hand-drawn strokes (squiggles, arrows, X marks, globes, speed lines)
marker_doodles.placement: Scattered energetically in the blue background, often crossing over the white paper edges
forbidden: perfect digital vector curves (must look hand-drawn)

torn_corner_accents.physical: Blank white textured paper scraps with jagged torn edges
torn_corner_accents.placement: Intruding from the extreme corners of the square canvas

do: Force all photos to be strictly black and white to contrast with the neon orange and blue
Ensure every letter in the headline looks like it was cut from a different magazine
avoid: realistic cohesive typography (kills the DIY zine vibe)
